units.source_text: 正在此时，派赴六条院的使者回来了。

en.t: Just then, the messenger sent to the Rokujo estate returned.

units.source_text: 他已喝得酩酊大醉，全然忘记了顾忌，公然地走到二女公子住处的正门前。

en.t: He was already dead drunk, had completely forgotten all caution, and openly walked up to the main gate of the Second Princess's residence.

units.source_text: 他掮着许多珍贵的犒赏品和服装，身体几乎被埋没。

en.t: He was carrying many precious reward gifts and robes, so that his body was almost buried beneath them.

units.source_text: 众侍女看见这模样，知道是送慰问信的使者回来了。

en.t: The waiting women saw him in that state and knew that the messenger who had delivered the letter of concern had returned.

units.source_text: 二女公子想道：“他在什么时候迅速地写这慰问信的？”

en.t: The Second Princess thought, "When had he managed to write that letter of concern so quickly?"

units.source_text: 匂亲王虽然并不强欲隐瞒此事，但觉过分公开，使二女公子难堪，希望使者稍稍用心才好，因此心中颇感痛苦；

en.t: Prince Niou had no strong desire to hide the matter, but he felt that it had become far too public and would embarrass the Second Princess; he wished the messenger had shown a little more discretion, and this pained him greatly.

units.source_text: 然而现已无可奈何，便命侍女将回信取来。

en.t: Yet there was nothing to be done now, so he ordered a waiting woman to bring him the reply.

units.source_text: 他想：“事已如此，应该尽力表示对她全无隐瞒。”

en.t: He thought, "Since things have come to this, I should do everything I can to show her that I am hiding nothing from her."

units.source_text: 便当二女公子面前把信展开。

en.t: Then he opened the letter in front of the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 一看，原来是六女公子的义母落叶公主代笔的，心中稍稍安慰，便把信放下。

en.t: When he looked, he saw that it had been written on behalf of the Sixth Princess by her adoptive mother, Princess Ochiba; feeling somewhat relieved, he set the letter down.

units.source_text: 虽然是代笔，在这里看毕竟很尴尬。

en.t: Even though it was written by another hand, reading it here was still awkward.

units.source_text: 信中写道：“越俎代谋，实甚失礼。

en.t: The letter said, "It is most discourteous of me to intrude and speak on another's behalf.

units.source_text: 曾劝小女亲书，但因心绪恶劣，不堪执笔，只得代为作复耳：

en.t: I urged my daughter to write in her own hand, but because she is in such poor spirits that she cannot take up the brush, I can only write this reply for her:
